segments.text_en: Cosmic decision and the returning heart
evidence: It was time to decide destinies in heaven and on earth,
Lagash had raised the head towards heaven in large ‘me’,
Enlil looked righteously upon lord Ningirsu.
The ‘heart’ of Enlil, it is the river Tigris, did it not bring sweet water?

segments.text_en: The king proclaims the temple's me
evidence: To the house its king spoke:
I will make the ‘me’ of Eninnu emerge in heaven and on earth.
The governor is wise, he shall pay attention.
The brick of deciding destinies lifted the head towards him,

segments.text_en: Gudea charged, resolves to seek dream interpretation
evidence: “Build his house!,” he ordered him.
Gudea, his ‘heart’ is distant,
Of what my ‘dark goat’ has revealed to me, its ‘heart’ I did not know.
Let me bring my dream to her, to my mother.
Nanše, my divine sister from Siraran, may she make its meaning visible for me.

segments.text_en: Voyage to Bagara and prayer to Ningirsu
evidence: Did he not set foot on his barge?
he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water,
Ningirsu, let me build your house for you, let me make the ‘me’ perfect for you.
His (Gudea’s) prayer was being heard.
In the House of Bagara he celebrated the week-festival.

segments.text_en: Prayer to the divine mother Gatumdu
evidence: I am a no-mother-haver, you are my mother.
You are a broad parasol, under your shade let me cool myself there.
With the index finger? of your right hand, ‘stroke’ me with it my lady Gatumdu.
Let me bring my dream to my mother,
His cry was heard.

segments.text_en: At Nina, recounting the dream to Nanše
evidence: You are the dream interpreter of the gods.
Inside the dream there was one man, his greatness was like heaven,
He spoke to me about the building of his house. His ‘heart’ I did not understand.
the brick of deciding destinies was placed in the mold for me.
A donkey stallion, on the right side of my king, scratched the earth for me.

segments.text_en: Nanše interprets the dream and gives instructions
evidence: “My shepherd, let me, me interpret your dream for you.
it is surely my brother Ningirsu. ‘Build his shrine, the Eninnu!’ He ordered you.
That is surely Nisaba, my sister.
Let me give you instructions, let my instructions be heeded.
He will reveal the plan of his house to you.

segments.text_en: Preparing chariot and emblem, entering Eninnu
evidence: The righteous shepherd Gudea learnt big, and now he will perform big.
He broke the seal of his treasure house, he brought out wood.
He fashioned his beloved emblem for him, he wrote his name on it.
in Eninnu, the white Anzu, he enters.
Joyfully he entered to him in the house.

segments.text_en: Second prayer, Gudea still cannot read the sign
evidence: Ningirsu, I will build your house for you, (but) my sign is my not.
I don’t understand its ‘heart’, your ‘heart’, surging, like the ocean,
Hero, your remote, like the heaven, ‘heart’,
I, what can I learn from you?

segments.text_en: Ningirsu's revelation of the sign and the promises
evidence: Gudea, I will surely give you the sign of the building of my house.
My house, Eninnu, founded by An, its ‘me’ is bigger than all the other enormous ‘me’
With the founding of my house, may abundance arrive.
I will build the house for you at day, at night I will let it grow for you.
On that day (when) your arm is touched with fire, I will teach you my sign.

segments.text_en: Waking, divination confirms, the light dawns
evidence: Gudea rose, it was a dream. He is afraid, it was a dream.
He struck the hand into the goat, his goat is good.
For Gudea, the ‘heart’ of Ningirsu it is the light, that dawned on him.
He learned big, and now he will perform big.

segments.text_en: Purification of the city and suspension of accusations
evidence: The governor cleansed the city, he spun it with fire.
A mother does not accuse a son,
An impure, a terrible one, a leper(?), he brought out from the city.
he made the brick appear by the goat,
it is Anzu, his royal emblem, he made it shine as a sign.

segments.text_en: The levy, mobilization of tribes, foreign submission
evidence: On that day, the governor arranged a levy in his land,
in the ‘tribe’ of Ningirsu, he made a levy for him.
The sun-disk, it is the emblem of Inanna, went at its head.
Elam came to him from Elam. Susa came to him from Susa.
Magan and Meluhha, from their land, submitted to him.

segments.text_en: Gathering materials from distant mountains and lands
evidence: To the land of cedar, where no man enters, for Gudea, the Lord Ningirsu made way for him.
He cut down its cedars with the great axe.
Purified silver is being brought down for Gudea from its mountain.
Carneol, like flowers, from Meluhha, it is being made plentiful for him.
From Kimaš, the mountain of copper, (that) revealed itself to him,

segments.text_en: Surveying and consecrating the temple ground
evidence: Enki made the plan of the house right for him.
the field was right, he measured it, he placed sticks on its border, he knew himself.
It is morning, he went in prayer to the old house.
The shiny basket, the righteous mold of deciding destinies, he raised to Eninnu.
(and) Ningešzida, his god, leads him by the hand.

segments.text_en: Making the sacred first brick
evidence: He raised the shiny basket, he stood by the mold. Gudea placed clay in the mold.
The cultic order emerged.
He greased it with honey, butter oil, and fine butter oil.
(About) his brick placed in the mold, Utu was pleased with it.
King Enki decided its destiny for him.

segments.text_en: Foundation laid, deities assist the building
evidence: He lifted the brick from the mold, it is a shiny throne raised to heaven.
She is establishing the plan of the house, it is Nisaba whose ‘heart’ knows counting.
Enki places the foundation of the house,
The mother of Lagash, Shiny-Gatumdu, bore its bricks in flows.
The En and Lagar stood in the house, they performed the me.

segments.text_en: The seven blessings and raising walls and doors
evidence: he placed the basket of the house, a shiny crown, on the head,
For the second (time) did he not give a blessing in the house?
It is Eninnu—Moon passing (through)—filling the land.
The house raised the head to heaven like a mountain in heaven and earth.
They place the wood of the door. It is the green sky lifting the crown.

segments.text_en: Raising the house, mast-foundation and great weapon set
evidence: The governor built the house, he made it grow, he made it grow like a large mountain,
he placed the very large mast, the foundation, its Abzu, in the ground.
He made Eninnu firm as a mast.
He placed the ‘multitude-eraser’, like a great sign, with Lagash
he brought them in a single year, he worked them in a single year,

segments.text_en: Naming the erected steles
evidence: His stone erected in the mighty courtyard,
as name of that stone he named.
the king, flood of Enlil, no-haver of opponent, Lord Ningirsu, on Gudea looked righteously,
lord Ningirsu, for Gudea, decided a sweet destiny,
Eninnu, knowing the face of An, Baba, life of Gudea,

segments.text_en: The completed house in cosmic splendor, the heart returns
evidence: Raising the crown like the new moon,
Gudea made Ningirsu’s house go out from the cloud like Utu,
made it grow like a mountain of Lapis,
it is the ‘heart’ of the gods, returned to its banks.
The righteous shepherd Gudea has learned big (things), and he will perform big (things).

segments.text_en: Placing the weapons and the trophies of dead heroes
evidence: At the war-door of the inner room, where the weapon hang, Sagar, the hero, the six headed ram, he seizes there.
the seven heroes he seizes there.
At Šugalam, the gate of radiance, the dragon and the date palm he seizes there.
Because they are dead warriors, he placed their mouths at the libation place,
Gudea, governor of Lagash, made them emerge.

segments.text_en: Catalogue of the finished temple's parts
evidence: The cedar doors standing in the house, it is Iškur roaring from heaven.
The fear of Eninnu covers all the lands like a garment.
From the brewery, (called) ‘Tigris is being water in its might’.
it is Anzu spreading his wings in Kurmuš.
rising in heavenly brilliance, like the moon.

segments.text_en: House finished in joy and closing praise
evidence: The house (was) built in joy by its king.
Gudea, governor of Lagash, placed its foundation.
For the restoration of Eninnu Ningirsu be praised!
The building of the house of Ningirsu, this is the middle of the praise.
--standing to be admired.
